prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1298; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the type and force of the impact, and the resulting right knee complaints are medically plausible given that mechanism. Over the course of care, the patient completed 27 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of knee injury, and progress was gradual. Examination revealed some findings that support a soft tissue injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, while other orthopedic tests and neurovascular assessments were within normal limits. The patient reports a prior minor strain in the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Review of the billing records shows that services were billed once as documented and without duplicate charges. Ongoing monitoring and home exercise instruction were provided, and the patient was advised to continue a graduated strengthening program.
